title: Crumble-Top Schnitzel
description: A German-inspired twist on the classic schnitzel, topped with a crunchy crumble.

ingredients.name: ethiopian spices
ingredients.notes: such as berbere or niter kibbeh

ingredients.name: crumble topping
ingredients.notes: made with buttery, flaky pastry dough

instructions: Season the pork cutlets with salt and pepper.
Dredge the pork cutlets in flour, then dip in beaten eggs.
Dredge the pork cutlets in the crumble topping, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the coated pork cutlets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crumble topping is golden brown and the pork is cooked through.
Serve with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of Ethiopian spices.
